node.statement: Let the registered power series defining (U^2)^{-1/2} be sum_{k>=0} a_k(U^2-x_0^2 I)^k, and suppose, as required for the registered theta constructions in def-compressed-corner, that it converges in norm for both U and iota_2(U). By the preceding unital-multiplicative identities, iota_2 sends every Nth partial sum at U exactly to the Nth partial sum at iota_2(U). Continuity of iota_2 permits passage to the norm limit, giving iota_2((U^2)^{-1/2})=(iota_2(U)^2)^{-1/2}. Multiplicativity then yields iota_2(sgn(U))=sgn(iota_2(U)), and unital linearity yields iota_2(theta(U))=theta(iota_2(U)).
